title: Robust Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning for Small UAS Separation Assurance under GPS Degradation and Spoofing
abstract: arXiv:2603.28900v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We address robust separation assurance for small Unmanned Aircraft Systems (sUAS) under GPS degradation and spoofing via Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL). In cooperative surveillance, each aircraft (or agent) broadcasts its GPS-derived position; when such position broadcasts are corrupted, the entire observed air traffic state becomes unreliable. We cast this state observation corruption as a zero-sum game between the agents and an adversary: with probability R, the adversary perturbs the observed state to maximally degrade each agent's safety performance. We derive a closed-form expression for this adversarial perturbation, bypassing the iterative inner optimization of adversarial training entirely and enabling linear-time evaluation in the state dimension. translated_abstract: arXiv:2603.28900v2 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：我们通过多智能体强化学习（MARL）解决了小型无人机系统（sUAS）在GPS降级和欺骗情况下的鲁棒间隔保障问题。在合作监视中，每架飞机（或智能体）广播其基于GPS的位置；当这些位置广播被破坏时，整个观测到的空中交通状态变得不可靠。我们将这种状态观测破坏建模为智能体与对手之间的零和博弈：以概率R，对手扰动观测状态以最大程度地降低每个智能体的安全性能。我们推导出这种对抗性扰动的闭式表达式，完全绕过了对抗训练中的迭代内优化，并实现了在状态维度上的线性时间评估。我们证明该表达式以二阶精度近似了建模不确定性集上价值函数的精确最小化器。我们进一步限定了...
tldr: 本文提出一种通过闭式对抗扰动表达式实现线性时间鲁棒多智能体强化学习方法，用于在GPS降级和欺骗下保障小型无人机系统的间隔安全，无需迭代内优化。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a robust multi-agent reinforcement learning method with a closed-form adversarial perturbation expression for linear-time evaluation, ensuring separation assurance for small UAS under GPS degradation and spoofing without iterative inner optimization.
